info.title: Football Market Catalog, Quote, and Token Purchase API
info.description: Protected local catalog and immutable quote read APIs. Account registration, login and key issuance are not public HTTP operations. Use one reader-supplied credential in the interactive page.

get.description: Locally stored players only; no live provider fetch. Ordered by case-insensitive display name, then stable player ID. Filters intersect by matching the corresponding nested player id. Omitted filters do not restrict results. Valid unknown or conflicting UUIDs return an empty 200 page. Unknown query keys are ignored and query-key order has no effect. Each supported parameter must occur once; blank, malformed, structured and repeated values are invalid. Opaque continuation token: do not decode or manufacture it. It is bound to the effective filter set. Equivalent UUID letter case and query-key order preserve that set; changing only page_size is allowed. Adding, removing or changing a filter with a cursor yields invalid_cursor. Traversal is not a snapshot. For authenticated invalid input, error priority is page_size, league_id, team_id, position_id, cursor. Supply exactly one credential. Authorization header names and the Bearer scheme are case-insensitive; credential values are exact. Missing, invalid, expired, repeated or mixed credentials return the same generic 401. Authentication runs before parameter validation or catalog access.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Omitted defaults to 25. Explicit value is one unsigned base-10 integer from 1 through 100. Blank, malformed, structured or repeated values yield invalid_page_size.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token: do not decode or manufacture it. It is bound to the effective filter set. Equivalent UUID letter case and query-key order preserve that set; changing only page_size is allowed. Adding, removing or changing a filter with a cursor yields invalid_cursor. Traversal is not a snapshot. One non-empty value only; blank, malformed, structured or repeated values yield invalid_cursor.

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: One UUID without surrounding whitespace matching the player league identity. Filters intersect by matching the corresponding nested player id. Omitted filters do not restrict results. Valid unknown or conflicting UUIDs return an empty 200 page. Unknown query keys are ignored and query-key order has no effect. Each supported parameter must occur once; blank, malformed, structured and repeated values are invalid.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: One UUID without surrounding whitespace matching the player team identity. Filters intersect by matching the corresponding nested player id. Omitted filters do not restrict results. Valid unknown or conflicting UUIDs return an empty 200 page. Unknown query keys are ignored and query-key order has no effect. Each supported parameter must occur once; blank, malformed, structured and repeated values are invalid.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: One UUID without surrounding whitespace matching the player position identity. Filters intersect by matching the corresponding nested player id. Omitted filters do not restrict results. Valid unknown or conflicting UUIDs return an empty 200 page. Unknown query keys are ignored and query-key order has no effect. Each supported parameter must occur once; blank, malformed, structured and repeated values are invalid.

200.description: Exactly data and pagination. data length never exceeds applied page_size. returned_count equals data length; has_more indicates another matching player follows; next_cursor is non-empty exactly when has_more is true, otherwise null. Empty pages retain all pagination fields.

400.description: One error code. For multiple invalid values, priority is page_size, league_id, team_id, position_id, cursor.

401.description: No usable credential; authentication precedes validation and catalog access.

get.description: Look up the stable player UUID. Malformed or unknown IDs both yield player_not_found. Supply exactly one credential. Authorization header names and the Bearer scheme are case-insensitive; credential values are exact. Missing, invalid, expired, repeated or mixed credentials return the same generic 401. Authentication runs before parameter validation or catalog access. Opening detail reads authoritative PostgreSQL freshness even after a cached catalog search. data is unchanged; statistics_status describes the configured provider and whole league-season coverage. Never-checked or expired scopes request one deduplicated background import without provider calls in this request. Existing queued, executing and retry_wait runs are reused. The default TTL is 86400 seconds from the complete accepted check; accepted unchanged, replay and complete-empty checks renew it, while failures do not. Transient exhaustion respects a configurable 3600-second cooldown and any longer provider retry hint. Permanent failures are blocked until trusted operator correction. Source selection and policies are server-controlled; no configured source returns unconfigured with local data. source_mode=fixture explicitly describes non-live data: fresh means a complete accepted check is within its TTL, not verified live-source accuracy. Import progress and valuation progress are independent; completed valuation may include explicit no_quote outcomes. Admission contention returns busy; admission failure returns unavailable while retaining local data. Do not cache this response as a substitute for opening detail.

post.summary: Buy available tokens using provisioned credits

get.description: Local committed quotes only. No provider calls or calculations. Supply exactly one credential. Authentication runs before date validation and player lookup. Malformed and unknown player IDs return player_not_found. Sequence (initial issuance = 0) is authoritative, with effective_at, inserted_at and id as descending tie-breakers for single selection. Prices are exact two-place decimal strings; timestamps are UTC. Initial issuance has null calculation, configuration, mapping and sequence metadata. Unknown query keys are ignored. Returns the highest persisted quote sequence. Existing players without quotes return quote_not_found.

Existing players without quotes return an empty data array.

get.summary: Get player quote at a UTC date
get.description: Local committed quotes only. No provider calls or calculations. Supply exactly one credential. Authentication runs before date validation and player lookup. Malformed and unknown player IDs return player_not_found. Sequence (initial issuance = 0) is authoritative, with effective_at, inserted_at and id as descending tie-breakers for single selection. Prices are exact two-place decimal strings; timestamps are UTC. Initial issuance has null calculation, configuration, mapping and sequence metadata. Unknown query keys are ignored. Requires one exact YYYY-MM-DD date. Returns the last eligible sequence effective through 23:59:59.999999 UTC that date, carrying forward through gaps. Dates before issuance return quote_not_found; future dates return the latest eligible stored quote. Missing, blank, structured, repeated or invalid dates yield invalid_date before player lookup. The quote retains its original effective_at.

parameters.description: One exact ISO calendar date in UTC. Latest quote on or before the end of this day.

get.summary: Read the active strategy player ranking
get.description: Returns locally retained successful quotes for the exact active saved configuration. This read uses a consistent read-only snapshot, does not call football providers, and never recalculates quotes. Results are ordered by unit price descending, then canonical player UUID ascending, with consecutive positions. The response is not cached.

200.description: Ranking for the identified active saved configuration; data may be empty.

503.description: The active selection or quote store is unavailable.

post.summary: Sell owned tokens to the market stand at the current quote

get.description: Returns the authenticated user’s immutable purchases and sales, newest completion first, with stable type and operation ID tie-breaks. Purchases are scoped by buyer_id and sales by seller_id. Cursor tokens are opaque, encrypted, and owner-bound. A continuation page remains anchored while newer operations are appended. Money values are exact decimal strings. This read does not mutate financial records.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Omitted defaults to 25. One unsigned base-10 integer from 1 through 100. Blank, malformed, structured, repeated, or out-of-range values yield invalid_page_size.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque owner-bound continuation token. Do not decode or manufacture it. Blank, malformed, structured, or repeated values yield invalid_cursor.

200.description: Transaction history page. data contains only the authenticated user’s purchases and sales.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, repeated or mixed credentials.

BearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>. Supply only this method when selected. Header and scheme case-insensitive; token value exact.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: X-API-Key: <key>. Supply only this method when selected. Header name case-insensitive; key value exact.

next_cursor.description: Non-empty when has_more is true; null otherwise.

data.description: At most the applied page_size players.

unit_price.description: Exact positive decimal credits per token; never a JSON number.

current_quote.description: Last persisted quote value in credits per token.

maximum_unit_price.description: Finite positive decimal string representing exact cents, without rounding.
